faqs.question: How long does Invisalign treatment take?
faqs.answer: Most Invisalign cases can be completed within 6 months, depending on the complexity of your case. The treatment is completely digitally planned which improves accuracy and predictability.

faqs.question: Is Invisalign noticeable?
faqs.answer: No. Invisalign uses clear, removable braces that straighten your teeth discreetly. You can straighten your teeth without anyone ever knowing.

faqs.question: What does composite bonding fix?
faqs.answer: Composite bonding can fix chipped, uneven, stained, or misshapen teeth. It's an instant, painless solution that reshapes and brightens your smile in just one visit.

faqs.question: How long does composite bonding last?
faqs.answer: Composite bonding provides long-lasting results. The exact duration depends on your care and lifestyle, but it offers a durable enhancement to your smile.

faqs.question: What teeth whitening options are available?
faqs.answer: We offer both in-clinic professional whitening and customised at-home whitening kits with professional-grade gel and custom-made trays for even application.

faqs.question: Do you offer free consultations?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer free initial consultations with one of our highly qualified dentists to discuss your smile goals and create a personalised treatment plan.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Absolutely thrilled with my Invisalign results at Rüh Dental Manchester. The team was so professional and my teeth are now perfectly straight. The money-back guarantee gave me complete confidence from day one.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Had composite bonding done to fix a chipped tooth and I couldn't believe the results. No drilling, no pain, and I walked out with a perfect smile the same day. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Emma L.
reviews.text: The professional teeth whitening at Rüh Dental made such a difference. My smile is noticeably brighter and the results have lasted. The custom trays are so comfortable to use at home.

reviews.author: Michael P.
reviews.text: Had the full smile makeover plan with Invisalign and composite bonding. The dentists really understood my vision and delivered exactly what I wanted. My confidence has completely transformed.
